tours.name: Review Team Calendar and Leave Conflicts

name_i18n.en_US: Review Team Calendar and Leave Conflicts

tours.description: Learn how a manager checks who in the team is away, spots days when too many people are off at once, and looks ahead in the calendar before approving leave.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how a manager checks who in the team is away, spots days when too many people are off at once, and looks ahead in the calendar before approving leave.

steps.title: Open Time Off
steps.description: The Time Off app also shows who in your team is away. Managers use it to plan work around leave and to spot clashes before approving requests.

description_i18n.en_US: The Time Off app also shows who in your team is away. Managers use it to plan work around leave and to spot clashes before approving requests.

steps.title: Overview
steps.description: Overview shows the leave of your whole team on one screen, instead of one request at a time.

description_i18n.en_US: Overview shows the leave of your whole team on one screen, instead of one request at a time.

steps.title: Team timeline
steps.content: This timeline shows the days of the period. Click it to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: This timeline shows the days of the period. Click it to continue.

steps.description: Each column is a day. The bars below show when people are away, so you can see at a glance who is out and when.

description_i18n.en_US: Each column is a day. The bars below show when people are away, so you can see at a glance who is out and when.

steps.title: Team member
steps.content: Each row belongs to one team member. Click a name to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: Each row belongs to one team member. Click a name to continue.

steps.description: A bar on a person's row marks the days they are on leave. The color of the bar shows its status, for example approved or waiting for approval.

description_i18n.en_US: A bar on a person's row marks the days they are on leave. The color of the bar shows its status, for example approved or waiting for approval.

steps.title: Total row
steps.content: The Total row adds up how many people are away each day. Click it to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: The Total row adds up how many people are away each day. Click it to continue.

steps.description: Use this row to find conflicts. A day with a high total means many people are away at once, so check that your team can still cover the work before you approve more leave.

description_i18n.en_US: Use this row to find conflicts. A day with a high total means many people are away at once, so check that your team can still cover the work before you approve more leave.

steps.title: Calendar view
steps.content: Click Calendar to see the same leave in a monthly calendar.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Calendar to see the same leave in a monthly calendar.

steps.description: The calendar is easier for planning by date. It shows the same leave requests as the timeline.

description_i18n.en_US: The calendar is easier for planning by date. It shows the same leave requests as the timeline.

steps.title: Who is shown
steps.content: The side panel chooses whose leave is shown. Click it to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: The side panel chooses whose leave is shown. Click it to continue.

steps.description: Tick or untick team members to focus on the people who matter for your work. The legend explains the colors: validated, to approve and refused.

description_i18n.en_US: Tick or untick team members to focus on the people who matter for your work. The legend explains the colors: validated, to approve and refused.

steps.title: Look ahead
steps.content: Click the arrow to look at the next period.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the arrow to look at the next period.

steps.description: Moving forward lets you check future weeks before you approve leave, so you can see whether other people are already away on those dates.

description_i18n.en_US: Moving forward lets you check future weeks before you approve leave, so you can see whether other people are already away on those dates.

steps.title: Back to today
steps.content: Click Today to return to the current period.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Today to return to the current period.

steps.description: Today brings you back to the current date from wherever you have scrolled to.

description_i18n.en_US: Today brings you back to the current date from wherever you have scrolled to.
